current.riftAtlasAimsToKeepCardDataSearchResults: Rift Atlas aims to keep card data, search results, and other tools useful and current, but the site is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. Content may be incomplete, outdated, inaccurate, or temporarily unavailable.

current.metafyBillingBody: Metafy operates membership checkout, payment processing, renewals, cancellation, and applicable refunds or billing disputes under the terms shown on Metafy. Rift Atlas does not receive or store your full payment-card details. The price, billing interval, and benefits shown on the Metafy checkout page at purchase govern that membership.
current.metafyEntitlementsBody: While an eligible Metafy membership is active and connected to the same Rift Atlas account, every paid tier grants its matching Rift Atlas badge and Discord role. Champion, Legend, and Signature Legend also grant access to the standard Simulator customization catalog; Legend and Signature Legend additionally grant their respective special tier nameplates. These are limited, personal, non-transferable digital access rights; they do not grant ownership of artwork, software, Riot-owned materials, or a commercial relationship with Riot Games.
current.metafyLifecycleBody: Canceling on Metafy may leave entitlements active until the paid period ends. Expiration, loss of access reported by Metafy, or a downgrade removes benefits that the current tier no longer includes. Saved customization selections may be retained but will not be applied while they are inaccessible.
current.metafyDisconnectBody: Disconnecting Metafy from Rift Atlas immediately disables membership-linked entitlements and verification, but it does not cancel the membership or stop billing on Metafy. Membership cancellation and billing changes must be completed through Metafy.
current.otherSupportBody: Other optional support or donation links that do not expressly list a Rift Atlas digital entitlement support the fan project only and grant no membership access or ownership rights.
current.toTheMaximumExtentPermittedByLawRiftAtla: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Rift Atlas is not liable for losses, damages, or costs arising from your use of, or inability to use, the site or linked third-party services.
current.riftAtlasMayUpdateOrDiscontinueAnyPartOf: Rift Atlas may update or discontinue parts of the site and may update these terms as the service changes. The current terms and their effective date will remain posted here, and material changes affecting active memberships will be communicated when required by applicable law.

current.starterKitCardsAreModeledAsNonFoilBecaus: Starter-kit cards are modeled as non-foil because published kit details do not specify their finish. Ordinary foil Rune frequency is also unpublished and is not currently modeled.
